## Marker-suite evidence (addendum) — the one failure is PRE-EXISTING, proven by control

Clean re-run: `pytest -m "not integration and not external" -n 4 --dist worksteal -q`
-> **1 failed, 10550 passed, 38 skipped, 4 errors** in 618.88s, exit **1**.

Both categories are accounted for, neither is this change:

**The 4 errors are self-inflicted.** All four read literally
`Failed: Test moved the repo HEAD (902ee42663 -> a6a6b621f9)` — that is MY OWN
`git commit --amend` landing while the suite was running (the first run had the same shape,
`34998a2ca8 -> 902ee42663`, my initial commit). Environmental, caused by me, not by the code.
Lesson recorded for the next agent: do not commit while the marker suite is running in the same
worktree; the suite's HEAD-stability and REPO_ROOT-leak guards both fire on it.

**The 1 failure is pre-existing on this checkout.** CONTROL RUN: I reverted all three changed
source files to the base revision (`git checkout 34998a2ca8 -- src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py
src/rebar/llm/runner.py src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py`, removing 229 lines of my diff) and re-ran
the single test. It fails **identically**:

    tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py::test_full_backend_account_is_present
    AssertionError: assert 'metric' in {'opengrep': {...}, 'ast-grep': {...}}
      where 'metric' = engine_b.BACKEND_METRIC
    1 failed in 9.36s     <- with my changes REVERTED

The `metric` grounding backend does not register in this local environment. Unrelated to usage
logging by construction and by control. Working tree restored clean afterwards
(`git status --short` empty).

**Verification that IS attributable:** `make lint` = 0, `make typecheck` = 0 locally, and Gerrit
CI (run 31031455490) is green on `lint + type-check` plus 9 other gates — eval-discipline,
artifact-provenance, optionality (x2), verify-identity, resolvable-ticket, pip-audit,
golden-path, clear-Verified. Only the 4-way pytest matrix is still running; that is the
authoritative marker-suite answer and the `Verified` vote depends on it.

Targeted clean runs, all attributable and green:
- `tests/unit/test_usage_log_run_shape_aec1.py` -> **7 passed** (plus 2 mutation checks -> RED)
- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.py` + `test_completion_gate.py` -> **121
  passed** (exactly the tests the contaminated first run had errored, confirming the default
  gate sink does not leak into REPO_ROOT)
